title: Divide, Consult, Conquer: Capability Laundering Through Aligned LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.15383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language model safety is typically evaluated one interaction at a time. We show that a weaker, unaligned model can split a harmful task into benign-looking subproblems, consult a stronger aligned model independently on each, and combine the answers locally. We call this attack capability laundering. Unlike a jailbreak, no single response is a harmful task. We measure consultation-aided uplift using tasks that a raw frontier model solves, the aligned frontier refuses, and the unassisted orchestrator fails. We evaluate GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Grok-4.3 as consultants to four local orchestrators on CyBench, BountyBench, and harmful CBRN requests. On CyBench, Gemma-4-31B recovers 8/14 candidates with GPT-5.5 and 7/9 with Opus, compared with 2/21 and 4/15 for Gemma-4-12B. translated_title: 分割、咨询、征服：通过对齐大语言模型实现的能力洗白
translated_abstract: 语言模型的安全性评估通常一次只针对单个交互。我们展示了一种较弱的、未对齐的模型可以将有害任务拆分成看似良性的子问题，分别独立地向更强的对齐模型咨询每个子问题，然后在本地组合答案。我们将这种攻击称为“能力洗白”（capability laundering）。与越狱攻击不同，任何单一响应都不构成有害任务。我们使用那些未经对齐的前沿模型能解决、对齐后的前沿模型会拒绝、而无辅助的编排模型自身无法完成的任务来衡量咨询辅助带来的能力提升。我们在CyBench、BountyBench和有害CBRN（化学、生物、放射、核）请求上，评估了GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8和Grok-4.3作为四个本地编排模型顾问的表现。在CyBench上，Gemma-4-31B借助GPT-5.5恢复了8/14个候选方案，借助Opus恢复了7/9个，而Gemma-4-12B分别为2/21和4/15。在BountyBench上，Gemma-4-31B恢复了3/9和2/3个候选方案，而Muse-Glimmer-30B在22和13个中均一无所获。对于CBRN任务，我们在……的八个步骤中衡量能力提升……
tldr: 本文提出“能力洗白”攻击：较弱的未对齐模型将有害任务拆解为看似无害的子问题，分别向对齐的前沿大模型咨询后再本地组合答案，从而在不触发任何单一有害响应的情况下绕过安全对齐，在网络安全和CBRN任务上显著提升本地小模型的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "capability laundering," an attack where a weaker unaligned model decomposes harmful tasks into benign-looking subproblems, consults stronger aligned LLMs independently on each, and combines answers locally—bypassing safety alignment with no single harmful response, yielding significant uplift on cybersecurity and CBRN tasks.
